question: What roles as breath-treasury, abode, victory, and victory-time knower define the deity?
premises: The deity is named as the treasury of apāna.
The deity is identified as an abode.
The deity embodies victory and knows its proper time.
inference: These epithets present the deity as a sustaining ground endowed with vital power, support, and timely conquest.
uncertainties: The precise referent of apāna in this epithet is not specified.
plain_english: He is the treasury of the outward breath, the abode, victory itself, and the knower of the time of victory.
